findings.title: SSRF audit log write deferred to future phase (FIND-005 partial)

evidence.snippet:
# In urls.py — SSRF_BLOCKED audit log write is in Phase 4 backlog
# Current: error returned to caller; security event not yet persisted

findings.description: FIND-005 (SSRF events not audit-logged) from the initial review was flagged as 'suggested' (not blocking). The router now surfaces SSRF_BLOCKED to the caller with the correct 422 response, but the AuditLog DB write is deferred to Phase 4 of the build sequence. This is acceptable for the current phase given no sensitive data is lost — the event is visible in application logs.
findings.attack_scenario: Low risk at current phase: SSRF attempts are correctly rejected and surfaced in structured application logs. The missing AuditLog DB row means security dashboards won't aggregate this event type until Phase 4.

remediation.summary: Track as Phase 4 backlog item. Add AuditLog write in the urls.py exception handler when exc.code == 'SSRF_BLOCKED'. See FIND-005 remediation in initial-code-review.json.

fixes_verified.verification: validator.py _BLOCKED_NETWORKS now contains 14 entries covering RFC 1918, loopback, 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local), 100.64.0.0/10 (CGNAT), TEST-NET ranges, and IPv6 ::1/128, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ::ffff:0:0/96. test_validator.py parametrize covers all ranges including the previously missing 169.254.169.254 AWS metadata endpoint.

delete_url now accepts requesting_user_id: uuid.UUID parameter. Line 'if url_obj.user_id != requesting_user_id: raise PermissionError("FORBIDDEN")' added before soft-delete. test_url_service.py::TestDeleteUrl::test_non_owner_cannot_delete asserts PermissionError is raised. Router maps PermissionError to HTTP 403.

_parse_ttl() helper implemented, handles P{n}D, P{n}W, PT{n}H, PT{n}M patterns. create_url applies it when request.ttl is set and expires_at is None. test_url_service.py::TestCreateUrl::test_create_url_with_ttl_string verifies P30D → ~30 day expiry with ±1 day tolerance.

rate_limiter.py bucket_key is now f'rl:{current_user.id}:{window_start}' — per-user isolation confirmed. test_routers.py::TestCreateUrl::test_rate_limit_exceeded_returns_429 mocks cache_incr to return 101 and asserts 429 + Retry-After header.

recommendation.rationale: All blocking findings (FIND-001, FIND-002) and suggested findings (FIND-003, FIND-004) resolved. One info-level item (FIND-P01 / audit log) deferred to Phase 4. Safe to merge to main with Phase 4 ticket open.
suggested_fixes: FIND-P01 — add SSRF_BLOCKED audit log write in Phase 4
